// diagnostic

E0922

Body-level `derive Debug;` remains retired; use the signed type marker or a hand implementation (D-AUTODERIVE-SYNTAX1=D)

What

Body-level `derive Debug;` remains retired; use the signed type marker or a hand implementation (D-AUTODERIVE-SYNTAX1=D)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0922

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0922: tests/ui/E0922_body_debug_derive.stderr.

Error [E0922]: `derive Debug` inside a type body is retired
  --> tests/ui/E0922_body_debug_derive.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     derive Debug
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: signed type markers are the one control for compiler-generated Debug implementations
 Fix: write `#Debug` before the type to opt in, `#!Debug` to opt out, or implement `Debug` by hand
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0922
